notes:
• Easier protein goal: default is now 1.6 g per kg (was up to 2.0). Plenty for muscle and cheaper.
• New: choose Budget, Standard or High protein in Settings → Profile & goal.
• Weekly grade is more forgiving: 90% of your protein goal counts as hit, and calories within ±10% are on target.
• If you set your own targets, they stay as they are.
